sections.html:
Land records in Nash County reach back to 1777, when the county was carved out of western Edgecombe County. Marriage records begin in 1862, and birth and death records start in October 1913.

Deeds dated 1777 through 1969 can be searched online. Newer ones come as paper copies, so a seller chasing down an older deed of trust or a plat should phone the office at (252) 459-9836. Anything recorded before 1970 can often be found from your kitchen table.

sections.h2: Is a house in Rocky Mount recorded in Nash County?
sections.html:
Sometimes, and sometimes in Edgecombe County, because the city of Rocky Mount straddles the line between the two. Check the tax parcel record for your lot before anyone drafts a deed.

Every other Nash County town sits wholly inside the county and records at the same office: Nashville (the county seat), Sharpsburg, Dortches, Castalia, Red Oak, Whitakers, Middlesex, Bailey, Momeyer and Spring Hope. A Spring Hope seller and a Sharpsburg seller file at the same counter, though their towns are at opposite ends of the county.

Documents recorded on or after July 1, 2002 must meet state paper rules, which the county's filing standards page boils down to a checklist. A deed that misses the mark still gets recorded, but the office adds a $25.00 nonstandard fee.

  • Letter (8 1/2 x 11) or legal (8 1/2 x 14) paper.
  • A clear 3 inch blank band across the top of page one.
  • Black type on white paper, at least 10 point.
  • Print on one side of each sheet.
  • The document type written directly beneath the blank band.

Blank spaces may be filled in with pen. Since October 1, 2011 the other margins on page one have been one quarter inch. If type is under 10 points yet still easy to read, the Register may waive the extra charge.

The 2025-2026 fee schedule sets the real estate charges below. The first four match the statewide amounts in G.S. 161-10, and the rest are items a seller or closing attorney may meet along the way.

Nash County Register of Deeds real estate fees, 2025-2026

Deed of trust, first 35 pages$64.00, then $4.00 per added page
Plat, each sheet$21.00

Excise stamps are priced at $1.00 per $500, covered in the next section.

sections.h2: Who pays the excise stamps when a Nash County house sells?
sections.html:
The seller does. Stamps run $1.00 per $500, and G.S. 105-228.30 makes the transferor owe the tax at the register before the deed goes on record. A leftover amount under $500 counts as a full unit.

Look for the stamp among the seller's charges on the closing statement. It has nothing to do with income tax on any gain, and its size follows the price stated in the deed.

Filers sign a Memorandum of Understanding and then receive a filing number. Call (252) 459-9836 to start that step.

Electronic filings are received on weekdays from 8:00 am until 4:30 pm, holidays excepted. Closing attorneys and title firms usually do the filing. Your part is to sign on time and ask which day the deed was submitted.

sections.h2: Splitting a lot before a sale
sections.html:
County planning fees show what a split adds. A recombination or exempt plat costs $25. A minor final plat of two lots or fewer with no road, water, sewer or drainage work costs $50 plus $10 per lot, and a zoning permit is $10. Recording fees for plats are paid to the Register of Deeds once the plat is approved.

New construction or additions inside Bailey, Castalia, Dortches, Middlesex, Momeyer, Nashville, Red Oak, Sharpsburg, Spring Hope or Whitakers need a zoning permit from that town's office before the county issues construction permits. A buyer hoping to add a room should hear that before closing.

Filing a plat sheet costs $21.00. The county's tax office sells copies of recorded plats at $4.00 for a full-size sheet and $1.00 for a reduced one.

sections.h2: Other services for estate and relocation sellers
sections.html:
Someone settling an estate or moving away often needs a few small items from the same counter.

  • Certified birth or death certificate: $10.00 each.
  • Marriage license: $60.00, and a certified marriage copy is $10.00.
  • Notary oath: $10.00, and authentication of a notary: $5.00.
  • Genealogy copy: $1.00 by mail or $0.10 in the office.

Ask the office which of these your sale needs, since the right papers depend on how title passed to you.

Under G.S. 47-18, a deed, option or long lease that never reached the register cannot be used against lien creditors or buyers who paid value, and whoever registers first wins. A parent's old deed that was signed but never filed is the classic example.

Recording a release of a paid-off deed of trust carries no fee. If a lender has merged or vanished, ask a North Carolina attorney to guide the cleanup before the listing goes live.

Before you list, pull your own deed and any open deed of trust from the office, and confirm that the names and legal description match what your agent will put in the contract. A cash buyer will want the same documents, though the closing skips lender paperwork.

Nash County had about 99,365 people in mid-2025, 4.6% above 2020. Owners lived in 63.6% of its 45,068 housing units across 2020 to 2024. The middle owner-occupied house was worth $191,000, and renters paid a median of $953 a month. Builders pulled 483 permits in 2025.

faqs.q: Who do I call about Nash County land records?
faqs.a: Call (252) 459-9836, the Register of Deeds number on the county filing standards page. Staff can explain e-recording sign-up and where older books are held.

faqs.q: What will the Register charge to file my Nash County deed?
faqs.a: Expect $26.00 up to 15 pages, then $4.00 more per page. Add $25.00 if the paper breaks the printing rules.

faqs.q: Is there a charge to file a loan payoff release in Nash County?
faqs.a: No. Satisfaction instruments carry no fee on the county schedule.

faqs.q: Which Nash County town offices issue zoning permits before building?
faqs.a: Bailey, Castalia, Dortches, Middlesex, Momeyer, Nashville, Red Oak, Sharpsburg, Spring Hope and Whitakers. The county issues its construction permits only after the town permit.

faqs.q: What are Nash County excise stamps on a deed?
faqs.a: They are the transfer tax receipt, priced at $1.00 per $500 of value and owed by the seller.
